source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 20 May 1949, p. 5 ("Unopposed returns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names as printed in the News-Letter's list of members returned unopposed on nomination day (two aldermen and 18 councillors)

note: Triennial election of Belfast Corporation, polled Wednesday 18 May 1949; eight aldermen of the old council were not due to retire until 1952 (Belfast News-Letter, 20 May 1949, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
